product_summary: Website euroindustriel.com presents the company as an industrial sourcing/procurement house ('Trusted Industrial Sourcing and Procurement Company', 'We help you source high-quality products', 'Broad Supplier Base in India and Globally'), not a manufacturer. Declared product lines: valves (13 types, DN 8–1500 mm, CI/CS/SS/bronze/ductile iron), fasteners (nuts, bolts, screws, washers, rivets, threaded rods, anchors, pins, nails), pumps (own brands Tusker Pumps — centrifugal and solar), motors, gearboxes, bearings, cables, compressors & blowers, transformers, inverters & batteries (Tusker Inverter, Tusker Batteries), seals, abrasives, tools, welding consumables, wire mesh, safety supplies. Target industries: desalination, irrigation, paper, power, process, steel, sugar, water/waste water. Contact on site: sales@euroindustriel.ae, EUI GLOBAL FZCO, Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE — i.e. the visible commercial entity is a UAE free-zone company, while the Indian Pvt Ltd is the sourcing arm.
comment: HS 848180 is corroborated by the site's own valve catalogue (gate/globe/ball/butterfly/check/control/PRV, DN 8–1500 mm) — exact match for the valve line. HS 732690 is only a residual 'other iron/steel articles' heading and does not properly describe the fastener range, which belongs in 7318 (bolts 731815, nuts 731816, washers 731822, screws 731815, pins/rivets 731829) and 7317 for nails; the declared pair therefore covers only a fraction of the actual catalogue. The declaration omits the bulk of the product lines: pumps (8413), motors (8501), gearboxes (8483), bearings (8482), cables (8544), compressors/blowers (8414), transformers (8504), batteries (8507), inverters (8504.40), welding wire (8311), wire mesh (7314), abrasives/tools (6804/8207). Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a misclassification: the site positions itself in desalination, irrigation, paper, power, process, steel, sugar and water/waste-water — i.e. general industrial MRO/procurement, not mining or metallurgy production. Trader signs are explicit: 'sourcing', 'procurement', 'supply and distribute', 'no minimum orders', 'broad supplier base', own brands (Tusker, Sintech, Vetta) presented as sourced brands rather than own factories. All product lines are заявлено, не подтверждено — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task, so no product is corroborated beyond the website catalogue. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, codes to be corrected to the actual range (7318 primary for fasteners, 8481.80 for valves, plus the omitted machinery/electrical lines). No registry, revenue or customs data researched per role scope.
